statement: Bounded-degree coboundary expanders. Constructs arbitrarily large finite d-dimensional simplicial complexes, for every d ≥ 3, with uniformly bounded vertex degrees and uniform 𝔽2 coboundary expansion in every degree below d. Together with the known graph and two-dimensional cases, this establishes the existence of such expanders in every positive dimension.
